name: QuantumArena

methods.name: create
methods.desc: Deploy. `treasury` should be a Falcon-1024 (PQ) account address.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.desc:
One-time ASA opt-in of the app account.
funding: ALGO payment to the app address covering the $GONNA opt-in MBR plus operating headroom.

methods.name: create_challenge
methods.desc:
Open a challenge. Group: [mbr pay, $GONNA stake axfer, app call].
The creator's score is committed sealed, already signed by the oracle.

methods.name: join_challenge
methods.desc:
Join an open challenge. ATOMIC: the stake axfer is in the same
group, so any assert failure here reverts the payment too.

methods.name: submit_score
methods.desc: Submit an oracle-signed score before the deadline.

methods.name: resolve
methods.desc:
Resolve a challenge. Permissionless.
Allowed when (a) the table is full and everyone signed (immediate, before deadline), or (b) the deadline passed and at least one joiner signed. Unsigned players forfeit their stake into the pot. Perfect tie among top scores -> everyone is refunded, zero fee.

methods.name: claim
methods.desc:
Creator reclaims the stake of a challenge nobody joined.
Only after the deadline, only if zero joiners, zero fee.

methods.name: claim_for
methods.desc:
Permissionless sweep of an un-joined, expired challenge.
Pays the CREATOR (never the caller). Available after deadline + 7d.

methods.name: early_close
methods.desc:
Creator closes an un-joined challenge before the deadline.
Costs 1 ALGO paid to the treasury (anti-spam), stake is returned.

methods.name: catastrophe_refund
methods.desc:
Permissionless total refund after deadline + 7 days.
Ultimate liveness guarantee: FUNDS CAN NEVER BE LOCKED FOREVER. Every payer is refunded in full, zero fee, forfeits included.

desc: QUANTUM ARENA escrow. One app instance escrows unlimited challenges.
